description: This Java class 'CodeHelper' provides utility methods for managing code entities such as 'COUNTRY', 'STATE', and 'ADDRESS_TYPE' within the Fineract project. It interacts with external APIs to create and retrieve code values, facilitating test setup or helper functionalities.

classes.name: CodeHelper
classes.description: A helper class for creating and retrieving code values such as country, state, and address type codes in the Fineract system.

methods.name: createAddressTypeCodeValue
methods.description: Creates a new address type code value given the address type name.

methods.name: createCountryCodeValue
methods.description: Creates a new country code value given the country name.

methods.name: createStateCodeValue
methods.description: Creates a new state code value given the state name.

methods.name: retrieveCodeByName
methods.description: Retrieves a code object by its name, throwing an exception if not found.

methods.name: createCodeValue
methods.description: Creates a code value under a specific code ID with provided data.
